lead: You bring your own Flickr API key. Each key allows 3,600 calls per hour and about 4 per second. The last 100 calls are kept for actions you start, like a download.
note: More keys or more nodes do not raise the limit of one key. Each key always calls Flickr from one node so that a block on one IP does not touch your other keys.
